blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to Santiago airport for your flight to Calama, the gateway to the Atacama Desert.

On arrival, meet your driver and transfer to San Pedro de Atacama.

In the afternoon, we head to the Valley of the Moon, Valle de la Luna, part of Los Flamencos National Reserve. Among the sharp ridges of the Cordillera de la Sal, unusually shaped rocks rise, sculpted by wind and salt.

At sunset, the sand and rocky ridges gradually change from gold to red. A freshly prepared Pisco Sour will be served: cold, citrusy and slightly tart.

After dark, the astronomy part of the programme begins. Atacama is known for its very dry air and clear skies. Away from the lights of the village, you will observe stars and objects in the southern sky through a powerful telescope. Your guide will talk about the constellations and galaxies of the southern hemisphere while the chef prepares drinks.

Transfer to your hotel and check-in.

**Included:** Valley of the Moon entrance ticket and cocktail.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, set out into the Altiplano with an English-speaking guide.

The route leads to the Atacama Salt Flat, the high-altitude lagoons of Miscanti and Miñiques, and the village of Toconao. The road climbs among volcanic slopes before revealing the mirror-like waters of the lagoons and the wide highland sky.

This part of the journey includes a gourmet lunch. The chef will prepare it amid the highland scenery, close to the lagoons and volcanoes.

After lunch, we head to the salt flat. At Chaxa Lagoon, in the Flamingo Reserve, you can see 3 of the 6 existing flamingo species. Against the white salt flat and dark volcanoes, their pink silhouettes stand out especially clearly in the water’s reflection.

If time permits, we will stop in the village of Toconao, where you can see the old Church of San Lucas and its bell tower.

Return to San Pedro de Atacama towards evening.

**Included:** entrance tickets to Chaxa and the high-altitude lagoons, and lunch.
